author: BPLC Team
description: 信号覆盖插件:由发现列表还原全网组网布局(MDS 多维标度 + 加权 stress 迭代),每个节点自带覆盖圈,圈内为其有向邻居;邻居距离由成功率/发现帧数估算。左侧布局画布(背景网格) + 右侧邻居列表面板(查看节点下拉框/选中节点信息/邻居表格/单向节点说明)+ 底部说明条,完整还原网页版布局。节点与覆盖圈配色对齐网页(选中橙/圈蓝/近邻绿/远灰)。点击节点、下拉框或右侧表格切换选中,滚轮缩放,拖拽平移,主题跟随主界面。
description_en: Signal coverage plugin: restores network topology layout from discover lists (MDS multidimensional scaling + weighted stress iteration), matching the hplc-coverage.html layout with left canvas (background grid) + right neighbor panel (node dropdown / selected info / neighbor table / unidirectional notes) + bottom notes. Node & circle colors match the web page (selected orange / ink blue / near green / far gray). Click node, dropdown or right table to recenter, wheel to zoom, drag to pan, theme follows the host.
name: cpp-coverage
